adminPage.title: OCR match results

reviewDrawer.title: Review OCR session
reviewDrawer.description: Correct any misreads, then commit the results to the leaderboard.

toast.noParticipantsToScore: No participants to score on this map.

participants.title: Participants
participants.infoTip: Add the teams or players competing. Search existing ones, or create a ghost placeholder for anyone not on the platform yet.
participants.descTeam: Search and add teams, or create ghost teams for entities not on the platform.
participants.descSolo: Search and add players, or create ghost players for entities not on the platform.
participants.empty: No participants yet. Add at least two to make a meaningful leaderboard.

results.title: Results per map
results.infoTip: Add the competing teams or players, add a map for each match played, then enter placement and per-player kills. Points are computed automatically from your scoring config.
results.descTeam: Add teams, then enter placement and each player's kills per map. Team kills are the sum of player kills.
results.descSolo: Add players, then enter placement and kills per map.
results.addInfoTip: Anyone you add here joins the leaderboard and gets a result row on every map. The search also finds existing ghost teams and players.
results.emptyTeams: No teams yet. Add them above; they appear here and get a result row on every map.
results.emptyPlayers: No players yet. Add them above; they appear here and get a result row on every map.
results.noMaps: No maps yet. Add a map to start entering results.
results.noTeamsToScore: No teams to score yet. Add them above and they will appear here with placement and kills inputs.
results.noPlayersToScore: No players to score yet. Add them above and they will appear here with placement and kills inputs.

confirmRemoveParticipant.title: Remove this participant?
confirmRemoveParticipant.desc: This removes {name} from the leaderboard and deletes their results on every map. This cannot be undone.

confirmRemoveMap.title: Remove this map?
confirmRemoveMap.desc: This deletes {map} and all results entered on it. This cannot be undone.
